glyph_origin: Phono-semantic compound (形聲): semantic 步 + phonetic 戉 to indicate the passing of time as "movement". Hence, the original version was close to 𢧁. In addition to 戉, various components such as 月 (“moon; month”) used to be present, sometimes as simple as two dots. The current form derives from the Qin-style handwriting of the late Warring States (with a full-width 止 on the top and a bottom-left 撇 stroke extending outward as in 戊 or 戌 instead of bending inward as in 戉), which was also inherited by the clerical script.
note: glyph_origin is from the traditional page 歲; s_page_origin explains the simplified 岁.
